title: So delicious!!
text: Such an awesome and informative class. We learned so much and got to taste the most flavorful pieces of ham! Highly recommend!
author: Jessica D

title: A lovely experience
text: Excellent. And Diego provided us not only with a lot of information but also a very pleasant moment. Totally recommendable-
author: nvecchi

title: Great Experience
text:
Veronica was fantastic!  She explained in depth how the ham was made and how it is eaten.  She was very passionate and made us feel very special.   The tasting was amazing and plentiful. 

Thank you Veronica!
author: Twringo
